annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EC) No 692/2008 implementing and amending Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EC) No 692/2008 implementing and amending Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions (Euro 5 and Euro 6) and access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 199/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation setting technical and administrative rules for type-approval of light passenger and commercial vehicles under Euro 5/6 emission standards, including on-board diagnostics, conformity of production, in-service conformity, replacement pollution control devices, and access to repair and maintenance information. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturers must obtain EC type-approval demonstrating compliance with Euro 5/6 emission test procedures.
All vehicles must have an OBD system detecting malfunctions over the vehicle's life.
Conformity of production and in-service conformity checks up to 5 years or 100,000 km.
Manufacturers must give independent operators access to OBD and repair/maintenance information.
Establishes Forum on Access to Vehicle Information and tamper-protection rules for emission control computers.
